concepts.definition: a continuous mark or path that can define edges, direction, movement, or structure in an artwork
a flat enclosed area defined by boundaries such as lines, colour, or value
a three-dimensional object or the illusion of three-dimensional volume in an artwork
the visual quality produced by reflected light and described through hue, value, and intensity
the actual or implied surface quality of an object or artwork
a system for representing three-dimensional depth and spatial relationships on a flat surface
the deliberate arrangement of visual elements within an artwork
the distribution of visual weight to create a sense of stability in a composition
the use of noticeable differences between visual elements to create emphasis or variety
art created by shaping, carving, modelling, assembling, or casting material in three dimensions
